data.description: RED task. Write e2e test (tests/scripts/test-rollback-bridge-cutover.sh or equivalent) that invokes dryrun-bridge-rollback-in-worktree.sh against a fixture repo with mocked gh binary. Asserts: (1) rollback script exits 0, (2) throwaway worktree removed on exit, (3) revert commit present in fixture repo history. Provides dd-2 (rollback dry-run proof) coverage.
data.title: End-to-end dryrun harness test against throwaway worktree (dd-2 proof)
